dct_description_sm: While most ecological studies focus on the impact of climate change on some populations or species, it becomes clear that ecosystem-based information is needed to better predict the future state of the Arctic. We therefore conducted a large-scale study aimed at characterizing the vulnerability of tundra ecosystems to climate change through modelling. As part of this study, we obtained variables describing climate of the province of Qubec north of the 50th parallel during three future time periods (2011-2040, 2041-2070, 2071-2100) at a fine resolution (10km x 10km grid cells) and under several climate change scenarios.
dct_title_s: Tundra Nunavik: Set of 27 gridded climate variables projected during the 21st century under 10 climate change scenarios
